Site.Url_Comment: The public address of the landing page, such as https://www.example.com/. Canonical links, the sitemap, shared links and QR codes use it.

ConnectionStrings.smtp_Comment: Endpoint=smtp://host:port;UserName=...;Password=... The same format as the app's server. With none, emails are logged instead of sent.

OpenAI.ChatApiKey_Comment: The same setting as the app's server, and the same user secrets, so one key serves both. With none, the chat streams a sample answer.
